newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-CELTICS' RADJA TO HAVE KNEE SURGERY, COULD MISS SEASON.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-CELTICS' RADJA TO HAVE KNEE SURGERY, COULD MISS SEASON.

text.p: Boston Celtics star forward Dino Radja will undergo surgery on his left knee Wednesday and will likely miss the rest of the season, the NBA team said Tuesday.
Radja will have arthroscopic surgery Wednesday morning at New England Baptist Hospital. The recovery period is expected to take three to four months.
The Croatian is the team's leading rebounder (8.4 rebounds per game) and is second to David Wesley in scoring, averaging 14 points a game.
Radja appeared in 25 games and shot 44 percent from the field (149-of-339) and 71.8 percent from the free throw line (51-of-71). He also leads Boston with 48 blocked shots.
